page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, page number at top left. One main text column, with a narrow marginal note in the left margin beside the text. Catchword at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.l: mori explicando sufficiant, liceat tamen quæ affert,
AlSbarestanius apponere, في كانت العرب جاهليتها يحرمون اشياء نزل القران بتحريمها كانوا لا ينكحون الامهات ولا البنات ولا الاخوات
ولا العمات وكان اقبح ما يصنعون ان يجمع الرجل بين الاختين او يخلف على امراة ابيه وكانوا يسمون من فعل ذلك الضيزن &c. Pro vetitis habuerunt Arabes

l.i: ignorantiæ suæ temporibus aliqua, quæ postea vetuit
eAl. Koranus; abstinere, siquidem a matribus, & à filiabus,
& à marterteris & amitis, turpissimum autem eorum
quæ faciebant hoc erat, quod vir duas sorores duceret &
Patris sui uxorem velut successor assumeret, quod qui fa-
ceret appellabatur{*} AlDaizan, quo nomine infecta-
tus est (inquit) Aus Ebn Hajar [Poëta] quosdam è
tribu BaniKais, quorum tres, ex ordine, patris sui

main_text.l: uxorem duxerant. وكان الرجل من العرب اذا مات عن المراة او طلقها قام اكبر بنيه فان كان لة
فيها حاجة طرح ثوبة عليها وان لم يكن حاجة يزوجها بعض اخوته بمهر جديد Mos autem erat a-

l.i: pud Arabes, ut cum ab uxore, morte aut repudio, separa-
retur aliquis, filiorum ipsius natu maximus, si eâ opus
haberet, vestem suam ei injiceret, quod si ille opus ea non
haberet, duceret ipsa è fratribus aliquò dotis nova inter-
ventu. Addi his possent ejusdem farinæ multa, sed è
jam dictis & quales invenerit Arabes suos Moham-
medes, & quales reliquerit, satis patere arbitror.

marginalia.note: Quod etiam Idoli nomen erat, AlIaoh. [?] & Kamus.

page.notes: Marginal note beside "appellabatur" is marked with an asterisk in the text. The name "AlIaoh" in the note is doubtful, the scan is small. "vetuit eAl. Koranus" is printed with the run-on "eAl." and may be "ei Al-Koranus"; kept as printed. The Arabic is transcribed letter by letter from a small scan. Words marked as doubtful in the Arabic are uncertain, and the Arabic line ends are approximate. The catchword "Quòd" is at the lower right and is not repeated in the text. Long s has been changed to plain s throughout.
